protocol.inference_precision: original FP32, cuDNN TF32 on, matmul TF32 off
protocol.metric: independent int64 confusion matrix; original validation protocol; tolerance 0.001 percentage points
protocol.norm_control: shared KD parameter-gradient L2 norm matched to teacher c1; detached coefficient
protocol.probe_precision: FP32, both TF32 flags off; eval BN/dropout; direct full-objective backward
protocol.probe_optimizer: actual SGD; original saved momentum restored before every virtual step
protocol.statistical_unit: 3 training seeds; stages and image pairs are repeated measurements, not extra seeds
limits: Different teacher weights, batch sizes, crops and learning rates confound dataset attribution.
Post hoc diagnostic; no new training, no model or temperature selection on validation.
CE checkpoint local virtual steps do not replay KD trajectories or establish trained mIoU causality.
